name: Steezelpunk
detailed_description:
Game Overview

Steezelpunk blends high-speed arcade racing with retro RPG-style progression and exploration, all set in a gritty underground racetrack world.
From the very start of the game, you’ll find yourself dropped into a cyber-steam-diesel-punk environment, beginning in a rundown garage where every object, tunnel, and corner hints at a larger world waiting to be uncovered. As you start to explore, you’ll race through twisting, maze-like tracks designed not just to test your reflexes, but also your ability to adapt, memorize routes, and find optimal lines.

Every track is full of hazards, alternate routes, and hidden shortcuts - making situational awareness and precision control just as vital as acceleration. You’ll have to study each environment and adjust your approach dynamically to stay ahead. As you progress, you’ll also unlock abilities that change how you interact with the environment, opening up new paths or helping you avoid obstacles more effectively.

Discovery and Exploration

The early missions are a smooth ride - light gathering runs that ease you into the rhythm of the world. But as the questline unfolds, the road turns rougher, with grinds that bite and races that demand everything you've got.



Challenging Racing, Soulslike Mentality

Every race is a test of skill. Sharp turns, unpredictable hazards, and relentless competition push players to refine their technique and react with precision.


Customization, Upgrades, and Exploration

Vehicle skins and skills can be unlocked. Hidden shortcuts, treasures, artifacts, high-risk detours, and rewarding challenges create a world where every choice matters.
In addition to performance upgrades, tons of unique skins let you personalize your ride visually. As you complete key elements of the game, the menu will also evolve visually. Meanwhile, powerful artifacts and collectible resources found throughout the game grant you passive skills and permanent enhancements that can influence how you approach each race. These combined with the Reset system creates a flexible endless experience that evolves over time.

Extended Gameplay, Open-Ended Progression

A full Playthrough is expected to take anywhere from 10 to 30 hours, depending on how you explore the environment. Races across a network of tracks, offering multiple paths and secrets to uncover. Mastering the terrain and finding the most efficient routes can make the difference between victory and defeat.


New Game+ / Reset System

Of course, once you Reset your stats and come back Stronger, you can play and upgrade your power forever. Let’s see how far you can push the grind!

Precision Controls, Designed for Mastery

The game’s unique control mechanics provide a level of responsiveness that rewards skillful play. It's worth getting to know your machine first, but once you do, it will dance the way you want it to.

Supported Inputs

This is a Single Player indie experience, with full support for Keyboard, Mouse and Controller.

Are you ready to take on the challenge?

Dive into the world of Steezelpunk and carve your path to victory. We'll see you on the tracks!

short_description: Steezelpunk is an indie racing game that blends high-speed retro racing with RPG exploration elements. Upgrade your stats and race through maze-like tracks. Level up your skills and loot out the map in a world where every race is a test of survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.8 GHz dual-core processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600/9600GT or ATI/AMD Radeon HD 2400/3400 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 480 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX
